result.question: What happened to seven Jewish exorcists?

readings.answer: They were overpowered by the man with the evil spirit and ran out of the house naked and wounded.
readings.support: jumped on them and overpowered them all | they ran out of the house naked and wounded

readings.answer: They were challenged by the evil spirit, who said, “but who are you?”
readings.support: the evil spirit responded, “Jesus I know, and I know about Paul, but who are you?”

assessments.reason: The passage says the man with the evil spirit jumped on them, overpowered them, and they ran out naked and wounded, which matches the key’s “Spirit beat them; they fled.”
The evil spirit’s taunt (“Jesus I know... but who are you?”) did occur to them in v.15, so it answers something that happened to them, though it omits the beating/fleeing focus of the key.

result.reason: Both the taunt and the subsequent beating/fleeing happened to them per the window, so more than one materially different answer fits.
